name: forgot-password
title: Forgot password page
description: Page-level password reset block: email and verification code plus a new password with a live strength checklist. Transport and navigation come from the host through props.
postInstall: Render <ForgotPasswordPage labels={...} port={...} /> inside your auth shell. The host supplies translated labels, a sendResetCode/resetPassword port, an optional initialEmail and navigates from onReset/onBack. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button, card, input and label.
